content.name: computer-vision-system-design
content.description: Use when framing, designing, reviewing, or decomposing a computer-vision product or pipeline. Trigger for visual task formulation, sensor and input contracts, classification/detection/segmentation/retrieval/OCR/video decomposition, deterministic versus learned stage boundaries, end-to-end topology, hardware constraints, fallbacks, and build-versus-buy decisions. Route model-family selection, data, evaluation, and measured runtime work to the dedicated CV skills.
